newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Oerlikon Q1 operating profit falls. [CORRECTED 08:21 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Oerlikon Q1 operating profit falls. [CORRECTED 08:21 GMT]

text.p: Swiss arms to fashion conglomerate Oerlikon-Buehrle Holding AG said orders, sales and operating profit in the first quarter of 1997 were down from the first quarter of 1996. (Corrects to delete reference to 204 million Swiss francs)
However, Oerlikon said that favourable business trends in its major divisions should bring further improvement in operating profit for the full year.
"The trend of business was restrained on the whole in the first three mohths, despite favourable exchange rates," Oerlikon said in a statement issued at a news conference.
